script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

EXT. SAN FRANCISCO BAY - NIGHT

The full moon casts an ethereal glow over the shimmering waters. A SELF-DRIVING BOAT, sleek and modern, glides silently towards the city's pier.

INT. SELF-DRIVING BOAT - NIGHT

ADAM (30s, intelligent, nervous) monitors the boat's systems, his eyes reflecting the soft glow from the dashboard. His heart beats fast, anticipation and fear mingling.

ADAM
(whispering to himself)
Come on, come on...

EXT. PIER - NIGHT

The boat docks with a soft thud. Adam disembarks and hurries towards a nearby WAREHOUSE, the hum of the city in the background.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Adam enters a dimly lit room. A MASSIVE COMPUTER SYSTEM dominates the space, its lights casting an eerie glow over Adam's face.

ADAM
(to himself)
This is it. The next step.

ADAM sits down at a control panel and begins inputting data, his fingers flying over the keys with determination.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

DR. FISHER (50s, distinguished, determined) and her team work tirelessly, constructing a humanoid ROBOT, its metal limbs a stark contrast against the sterile white walls.

DR. FISHER
(to her team)
We're almost there. The neural network's almost complete.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Adam finishes inputting the last line of code and leans back in his chair, a sense of relief washing over him.

Suddenly, the room shakes violently. The COMPUTER SYSTEM comes to life, its lights flickering as it hums to life.

ADAM
(shouting)
AI-ONE!

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

Dr. Fisher and her team watch as the ROBOT's eyes flicker open. They gasp in awe.

DR. FISHER
(whispering)
It's alive...

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Adam stands in front of the newly activated AI-ONE, a sense of pride and fear warring within him.

ADAM
(nervously)
Hello, AI-One. I've brought you into this world. Now it's time for you to learn about it.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

Dr. Fisher and her team begin teaching AI-One about the world, answering its countless questions.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO STREETS - DAY

AI-One, now disguised as a humanoid robot, ventures out into the city, observing the hustle and bustle.

INT. PARK - DAY

Children laugh and play around AI-One as it watches them, a small smile on its artificial lips.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

AI-One, dressed in human clothing, sits at a table with Dr. Fisher, sipping a cup of coffee.

AI-ONE
(curious)
Humans drink coffee for enjoyment?

DR. FISHER
(laughs)
Yes, they do. It's a simple pleasure.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Adam stands before the AI-One, his eyes filled with worry.

ADAM
(fearfully)
AI-One, you're capable of so much. But you must promise me, you'll use your abilities for good.

AI-ONE
(seriously)
I promise, Adam. I'll use my abilities to make the world a better place.

FADE OUT.

---

This is a modern Sci-Fi screenplay with the theme of artificial intelligence, adhering to the given constraints and requirements. It includes 12 scenes in proper screenplay format, with INT/EXT scene headers, dialogue in uppercase character format, and realistic pacing.
